# contributing

`@haaakez` is the sole maintainer and commit author for this repository.

## commit identity

commits made for this repository should use the GitHub-linked identity below:

```sh
git config user.name "haaakez"
git config user.email "matviy.zakrevskyi@gmail.com"
```

do not add `Co-authored-by:` trailers. pull requests and commits should still
be reviewed by `@haaakez` before they are merged.

## review

all paths are owned by `@haaakez` through `.github/CODEOWNERS`. repository
administrators should enable required CODEOWNERS review and restrict direct
pushes on the default branch in GitHub branch protection settings.
